edits.new:
For an unresolved named subject, retain its name.

URLs and opaque encoded identifiers—such as Nostr public keys (`npub1…`), event IDs (`nevent1…`), and cryptographic hashes—provide no subject evidence. The surrounding prose may still establish subjects involving URLs or identifiers.
edits.old: For an unresolved named subject, retain its name. Exclude labels, credits, or identifiers used merely to present the content.
